name: 廚房與飲食
topic: 點餐、冰品、廚房用具、food 相關動詞(B2)

cards.example: Can I get two scoops in a cup?
One scoop on a cone, please.
The sugar cone stays crunchy longer.
cards.exampleZh: 脆皮甜筒比較久才會軟。

cards.example: A waffle cone costs a dollar extra.
cards.exampleZh: 華夫餅甜筒要多一塊錢。

cards.example: They only have soft serve after eight.
cards.exampleZh: 八點後他們只剩霜淇淋。

cards.example: Sorbet is dairy-free, right?
cards.exampleZh: 雪酪是不含乳製品的對吧?

cards.example: The gelato here beats any ice cream.
cards.exampleZh: 這裡的義式冰淇淋比任何冰淇淋都好。

cards.example: I'll take a hot fudge sundae.
cards.exampleZh: 我要一份熱巧克力聖代。

cards.example: Can you add sprinkles on top?
cards.exampleZh: 可以在上面加巧克力米嗎?

cards.example: Which toppings come free?
Go easy on the syrup.
This milkshake is way too thick.
The kids each grabbed a popsicle.
cards.exampleZh: 小孩每人拿了一支冰棒。

cards.example: For here or to go? — To go, please.
cards.exampleZh: 內用還是外帶?外帶,謝謝。

cards.example: I'll get a large coffee to go.
cards.exampleZh: 我要一杯大杯咖啡外帶。

cards.example: Where do you keep the peeler?
Flip it with a spatula.
Whisk the eggs until they're fluffy.
Use the tongs, not your fingers.
Pass me the ladle for the soup.
I grated the cheese with a grater.
cards.exampleZh: 我用刨絲器把起司刨絲。

cards.example: Drain the pasta in a colander.
cards.exampleZh: 用濾水籃把義大利麵瀝乾。

cards.example: Don't cut straight on the counter — use a cutting board.
cards.exampleZh: 不要直接在檯面上切,用砧板。

cards.example: Grab an oven mitt, that tray is hot.
cards.exampleZh: 拿隔熱手套,那盤子很燙。

cards.example: The kettle takes about two minutes.
Just throw it in the rice cooker.
Heat the frying pan first.
Put the lid on or it'll splatter.
Cover the bowl with cling film.
Wrap the fish in aluminum foil.
Store the leftovers in a ziplock bag.
I brought lunch in a container.
cards.exampleZh: 我用保鮮盒裝午餐帶來。

cards.example: Leave them in the dish rack to dry.
That sponge smells — toss it.
cards.exampleZh: 那塊菜瓜布有味道了,丟掉吧。

cards.example: I keep tea in a thermos all day.
cards.exampleZh: 我一整天都用保溫瓶裝茶。

cards.example: Bring a tumbler for the discount.
The bread went stale overnight.
cards.exampleZh: 麵包一個晚上就不新鮮了。

cards.example: Check the date — this milk looks expired.
cards.exampleZh: 看一下日期,這牛奶好像過期了。

cards.example: Defrost the chicken before you cook it.
Just reheat it in the microwave.
cards.exampleZh: 用微波爐加熱一下就好。

cards.example: Marinate the beef for an hour.
Let it simmer for twenty minutes.
It needs more seasoning.
The milk smells a bit sour.
cards.exampleZh: 牛奶聞起來有點酸掉了。

cards.example: This coffee is way too bitter.
The steak was a little chewy.
The fries got soggy in the bag.
